justification: Deterministic SEPP clause-label fix (67 rows: label := the law unit the row's words sit in, 64 re-copied verbatim) plus a trailing-next-heading rule for the number check (16 rows re-copied), applied live 2026-10-17 with backups; also the not-a-rule withhold lists (Ashfield E1 Part 9 905, Ku-ring-gai legend 87, SEPP overlap/paraphrase/fragment 228, user yes). DQ-145 measured 860 -> 430 by python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-145; ceiling lowered to 430.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_sepp_ref_fix.py tests/test_sepp_marker_blind.py tests/test_outreach_claim_checks_oc20.py && python scripts/verify_sepp_marker_blind.py data/sepp_ref_fix_plan_2026-10-17.json data/sepp_ref_fix_evidence_2026-10-17.jsonl
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a label is not the grammar label of its unit or fails the site's display check, the label-blind unit search picks a different unit, two schedules holding the same words are not refused, a heading inside a row body is stripped, or DQ-145 exceeds 430
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the verifier used the same heading strip as the planner, the live apply refused 3 rows (22346, 12653, 12655: 'a number of the old text is missing from the new text') and wrote nothing; with the strip in both, 16 verified and were written. Not run: a mutation of strip_trailing_headings itself.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/sepp_ref_fix.py: reads production read-only with the same SQL as sepp_marker_blind.SQL; unit decisions run against the cached legislation HTML whose sha256 the verifier checks against the manifest
real_layer_exempt.scripts/apply_sepp_marker_blind.py: the live apply ran: 67 then 16 rows written, every row guarded on md5 and old ref_number at write time, post-write state re-read before commit

pre_impl.existing_data: sepp_marker_blind decide/find_seq/decide_recopy, verify and apply scripts from #1321; withhold_state_paraphrase.py --list/--council for the withholds
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: ref_unit mapped 'Schedule 2 cl 6' to the whole schedule; now to sch.2-sec.6. The 43 #1321 rows still verify 43/43.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: reuses decide() unchanged for the final verdict; adds a label-blind search (ignore_ref) and a unit-id -> label grammar; the withholds reuse the existing script with new lists

functions.name: unit_label
functions.input: a law unit id such as sch.11-sec.4 or sec.3.4-ssec.2-para1.e
functions.if_none: None for notes, tables, parts or a bare schedule -> the row is refused unit_not_a_clause

functions.name: strip_trailing_headings
functions.input: one stored row's provision text, possibly None
functions.output: the text minus Part/Division/Subdivision/Chapter/Schedule heading lines at its very end
functions.if_none: returns an empty string, never raises

values.read_at: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-145 on 2026-10-17 after all five live writes

break_it.scenario: the same words appear in several schedules (e.g. 'Clause 5' found in six)
break_it.what_happens: refused ambiguous_unit; the row stays unproven with its mark
break_it.how: label-blind search keeps the peer check; never picks by sort order

break_it.scenario: a row's real measurement sits on its last line
break_it.what_happens: kept in the number check; the row is refused if the law unit lacks it
break_it.how: only lines shaped 'Part|Division|... N Title' are stripped, and only at the end

break_it.scenario: a row changed between plan and write
break_it.what_happens: the UPDATE matches 0 rows and the whole apply rolls back
break_it.how: md5(provision_text) and ref_number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM the planned old values
break_it.repro: edit one row's text then run the apply

mutation_analysis: Not executed. By reading: strip_trailing_headings -> identity would break test_trailing_part_heading_is_stripped_for_numbers and test_two_trailing_headings_are_stripped (both assert the stripped string); the verifier re-derives every label from its unit id, so a wrong grammar label fails verification.
residual_risk: 110 ref_mismatch rows stay unproven (69 ambiguous). 81 unit_too_big rows stay unproven with the mark. The Ashfield E1 Part 9 history text is withheld from every Ashfield address; a heritage-area statement of significance is not shown anywhere until it is keyed to its area.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach on main prints 21 of 21
